data.narrative:
Flock Safety is a Series G defense and security company with a last post-money valuation of $7.5B and $1.4B+ in cumulative capital raised. The peer set comprises 11 same-sector comparables across similar valuation tiers, including 8 private companies (Shield AI at $12.7B, Helsing at $18.0B, Saronic at $9.2B) and 2 public equities.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, anchored to the $7.5B Series G valuation with a 1.25x step-up multiplier typical of late-stage progression, implies $9.4B. Peer-median analysis across the 11-company Defense & Security cohort yields a median valuation of $4.4B, with a range spanning $2.1B to $18.0B. The dispersion reflects heterogeneity in stage (Series C through Series G) and technology maturity within the sector.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $3.7B (low) to $10.8B (high), with a median of $6.9B. The current $7.5B post-money sits above the peer median but below stage-progression upside, reflecting Flock Safety's position as a mature late-stage operator. Key uncertainties include the applicability of the 1.25x multiplier given capital intensity in defense tech, and compositional variation among peers with respect to deployment maturity and recurring revenue traction.
